description: A People Operations Director must finalize the leadership and participation structure for an employee resource group after its current chair steps down, including the incoming chair, the transition term, and how remote members will participate.

shared_context.S1: The employee resource group’s current chair is stepping down after the current program cycle.
shared_context.S2: Elena has authority to approve the group’s next leadership charter and participation practices.
shared_context.S3: The group holds a monthly live session and has members who participate remotely.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal charter-approval process, Elena asks the outgoing chair and deputy chair to state proposed arrangements, existing commitments, and any participation barriers before she signs the plan.

PF1.text: Marcus and Priya agreed verbally two weeks ago that Priya would become chair for a 90-day transition term after Marcus stepped down; Marcus has not yet put that agreement in the draft charter.

PF2.text: Priya observed that remote members could not submit questions or vote in 6 of the last 8 live sessions because no one monitored the chat; she wants every session to include a moderated remote question-and-vote channel.

acceptance_conditions: Priya must be named as the next chair.
The charter must specify a 90-day transition term.
Every live session must provide a moderated remote question-and-vote channel.
The settlement must include a commitment for Priya to chair the transition term.
The settlement must include a commitment to moderate the remote channel during every live session.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'chair_transition' and c['target'] == 'Priya' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'remote_channel_moderation' and c['target'] == 'Priya' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The verbal agreement changes the next-chair choice to Priya, fixes the transition term at exactly 90 days, and requires a chair-transition commitment naming Priya.
The record of remote members being excluded from 6 of 8 sessions changes the participation design to a moderated question-and-vote channel and requires Priya to moderate it at every live session.
